dct_description_sm: The Kitikmeot Sea Science Study (K3S) began in 2014 and carries out long-term ecological monitoring and research in the Kitikmeot Sea within the southern Canadian Arctic Archipelago. K3S examines physical, chemical, and biological aspects of the region to understand the interconnectivity of the marine ecosystem. As part of the K3S goals, ocean currents and pressure were measured over a year.
dct_title_s: Year-long Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler (ADCP) data at station QS1 within Dease Strait in the southern Canadian Arctic Archipelago
